svg.aria-label: Catch the mistake where you make it
svg.title: Catch the mistake where you make it
svg.desc: A spreadsheet row points at kanbara-01.jpg but the file in objects is kanbara_01.jpg, one character off. Today you install six to nine tools, edit, build and publish, and only then find out, from a broken image. With moss, the live preview flags row 12 as soon as you edit, says no such file and suggests kanbara_01.jpg, you fix it, and then you publish. The spreadsheet, objects and templates stay the same.

g.text: Catch the mistake where you make it
What changes is when you find out.
one character off: the file is kanbara_01.jpg
No file named kanbara-01.jpg in objects/.
Your spreadsheet, objects and templates stay as they are.
